setting_rationale: A fixed stricter negative-side confidence illustration (0.95), chosen before this comparison; not an empirical clinical risk bound or a course-imposed value.
next_evaluation_intent: Preserve the primary reference analysis and report BOTH predefined secondary variants alongside it; no best-on-test policy selection.
caution: Research-only secondary analysis. No model, primary classification cutoff or existing operating rule is changed. The 0.05 cap is a fixed experimental choice, not proof of 95% correctness. These validation patients have already been used repeatedly for model and policy development; cross-fitting does not undo that reuse. Referrals are not diagnoses. A no-auto-CN policy has zero automated negative errors by construction, not demonstrated clinical safety or 100% diagnostic sensitivity. Version 1 has already exposed the test cohort. This extension performs no new test evaluation.
